author: PostOakLabs
description: Pre-sign gate for one EIP-3009 (ERC-3009, Draft) transferWithAuthorization or receiveWithAuthorization intent, decided against a caller-declared spend policy and a caller-pasted authorization ledger. Returns exactly one decision: SPEND, DENY, OVER_LIMIT or INDETERMINATE, with per-rule reason codes and window headroom. The gate reads declared inputs only: no digest recomputation, no signature recovery, no chain reads, no network calls. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.

authorization_json.description: The authorization under decision: variant, from, to, value, validAfter, validBefore, nonce, optional authorization_intent_ref

domain_json.description: EIP-712 domain as signed: name, version, chain_id, verifying_contract

ledger_json.description: Past authorization entries: from, token, chain_id, nonce, to, value, validBefore, signed_at, status, optional intent_ref

policy_json.description: Caller-declared spend policy: agent_address, allow and deny lists, caps, windows, velocity and ceilings; absent members are legal

mcp_tool_definition.description: Decides SPEND, DENY, OVER_LIMIT or INDETERMINATE for one EIP-3009 (ERC-3009, Draft) authorization against a caller-declared spend policy and a caller-pasted authorization ledger, with every failing rule listed and the first failing rule primary. Zero network calls, no signature recovery, no chain reads; the nonce check runs against the pasted ledger only. Checks pasted inputs only; not financial advice. Client-side only, zero PII.

authorization.description: The authorization under decision: variant, from, to, value, validAfter, validBefore, nonce

domain.description: EIP-712 domain as signed: name, version, chain_id, verifying_contract

ledger.description: Past authorization entries with status signed, settled or canceled

policy.description: Caller-declared spend policy: agent_address, payee lists, caps, windows, velocity, ceilings

mcp_tool_definition.name: run_eip3009_agent_spend_gate

authorization_echo.description: Normalized authorization and domain fields the decision read

exposure.description: Outstanding signed-unexpired total and settled total inside the declared duplicate window

headroom.description: Per-transaction, per-window and velocity headroom against the declared caps

not_evaluated.description: Rules that could not run because their policy input was absent

primary_reason.description: The first failing rule in the fixed thirteen-rule order

reasons.description: Every failing rule with observed and declared values

receipt.description: Gate identifier, decision, rule counts, caller clock and scope note

refusals.description: Structured refusal reasons; present only when the call is refused

warn_count.description: Number of caveat flags raised by the run

title: EIP-3009 Agent Spend Gate
